notes:
EXP34-C ORACLE COVERAGE, PART B (strict-only keys), hostap: wpa_supplicant/events.c through wpa_supplicant/wpa_priv.c. These 129 keys are in-scope EXP34-C findings that aurora-lint d21be1b3d reports only at the strict preset (run sqc-0.6.0-d21be1b3d-strict-*; strict sets first_site_only=false and reports every dereference site, not only the first) and that no label covers. Same standard and method as coverage-exp34c-2026-10-calibration and coverage-exp34c-2026-10-part-a-curl-hostap-mbedtls-mosquitto: the dereference is the violation site, judged at strict under EXP34-C/2026-10-07/presets; FP needs proof in the scanned source, a language guarantee, or an ISO C or POSIX library contract (those rows also cite P/facts); open caller sets for exported functions; a strippable assert, a noreturn attribute and an earlier dereference of the same pointer are not proof. A later site inherits an earlier site's FP only when that proof also dominates it with no reassignment between. One read-only research reader drafted each verdict at source in the pinned checkout; the adjudicator reviewed every draft (format and vocabulary, every nearby opposite-verdict label, a source re-read of a sample and of the questioned rows) before inclusion.

RESULT: 21 FP, 108 TP.

TP shapes: data in wpa_supplicant_event and wpa_supplicant_event_global and in the sme.c statics it reaches; open cred and ssid parameters; wpa_priv's event path (wpa_priv links with LDFLAGS, which take -rdynamic under CONFIG_WPA_TRACE); sme_send_authentication's bss after an untested wpas_ml_connect_pref under CONFIG_TESTING_OPTIONS. FP shapes: bss->bssid evaluated only when params.mld is false; interworking helpers whose every call site passes a loop cursor, a tested cred or selected_cred set together with selected (medium; these name conflicts with older TP labels that did not accept the correlation).

79 row(s) name a conflict in provenance with a carried-forward label that predates the 2026-10-07 rulings; existing rows are not edited.

Counting basis: distinct (project, commit, file, line, rule) keys. No precision or recall claim is made here.
